verdict.rationale: Apify's own web-scraper Actor documents a configurable page cap through the maxCrawlPages input, shown in the official JS client example. Apify also names Crawlee as its own crawling library. No evidence shows a selectable breadth-first crawl strategy or documented deep-crawl depth controls. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first crawl strategy, depth/deep-crawl configuration, docs detailing maxCrawlPages semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit

citations.quote: Crawlee - our own web crawling and browser automation library
